creative_direction: Create a cloud-shaped runner entirely in raised wool embroidery on deep navy linen. Its body is a compact uneven cloud stitched in burnt orange, with two short cyan fabric boots below and one small stitched eyebrow over a dark dot eye. The runner leans forward in mid-stride, conveying cheerful determination without a wide grin. Change stitch direction across the cloud lobes so the form emerges from thread structure rather than painted shading. Include a few visible anchoring stitches around the boots and a cream thread highlight along one edge. Keep the composition isolated and centered, occupying the safe inner circle of the square. No hoop, border, lettering, or surrounding decorative motifs.
